mc_hinglish.name: MC-Hinglish1.0
mc_hinglish.paper: Rahman-Laskar, Gupta, Badhani & Pinto-Avendano (2024). Cyberbullying Detection in a Multi-classification Codemixed Dataset. Computacion y Sistemas 28(3). doi:10.13053/CyS-28-3-4989
mc_hinglish.role: primary train/val/test (cyberbullying type, 7 classes; derived binary)

swami_sarcasm.name: English-Hindi Code-Mixed Sarcasm Corpus (Swami et al., 2018)
swami_sarcasm.paper: Swami, Khandelwal, Singh, Akhtar & Shrivastava (2018). A Corpus of English-Hindi Code-Mixed Tweets for Sarcasm Detection. arXiv:1805.11869
swami_sarcasm.role: human-annotated sarcasm supervision for the sarcasm component

conda.name: CONDA: CONtextual Dual-Annotated in-game toxicity dataset
conda.paper: Weld et al. (2021). CONDA: a CONtextual Dual-Annotated dataset for in-game toxicity understanding and detection. Findings of ACL-IJCNLP 2021. doi:10.18653/v1/2021.findings-acl.213
conda.license: not specified in repository (used for non-commercial research evaluation only; not redistributed)
conda.role: PROXY sequential dataset for the early-detection mechanism (English game chat toxicity, not cyberbullying, not Hinglish). Official test file is unannotated and not used.

tweeteval_offensive.name: TweetEval - Offensive (OLID / OffensEval-2019 data)
tweeteval_offensive.paper: Barbieri et al. (2020) TweetEval, Findings of EMNLP 2020; data from Zampieri et al. (2019) OLID, NAACL 2019
tweeteval_offensive.role: English external stress test only (label = offensive language, NOT cyberbullying)

user_sarcasm_human.name: User-supplied Hinglish sarcasm comments (human + AI labels)
user_sarcasm_human.paper: UNKNOWN - provenance not documented by the project; could not be matched to a public release
user_sarcasm_human.access: local file supplied by the project owner (human_labelled_features.csv)
user_sarcasm_human.role: SUPPLEMENTARY cross-corpus sarcasm test only; excluded from all headline results

user_sarcasm_ai.name: User-supplied Hinglish comments with LLM-generated sarcasm labels
user_sarcasm_ai.access: local file supplied by the project owner (ai_labelled_features.csv)
user_sarcasm_ai.role: NOT USED for training or evaluation: labels are machine-generated, not ground truth

unavailable.hasoc: HASOC (FIRE 2019-2021): data is released to registered participants via the organisers' form at https://hasocfire.github.io/ . Unofficial HF re-uploads exist but have no clear licence, so they are not used.
unavailable.trac: TRAC-1/TRAC-2 aggression data: distributed by the organisers on request (https://sites.google.com/view/trac2/ ; https://sites.google.com/view/trac1/). Not downloaded.
unavailable.bohra2018: Bohra et al. (2018) Hinglish hate speech: repository ships tweet IDs + labels only (id_annotated.tsv); text requires X/Twitter API hydration, which is not available.
unavailable.olid_official: OLID official zip is hosted on a Google Sites page; the TweetEval redistribution (identical OffensEval-2019 test tweets) is used instead.
